Usage: rig scope slice close [options] <slice-path>

Close a slice (move to <mission>/closed/ by default, or update status in place
with --in-place)

Arguments:
  slice-path         Slice path (absolute, relative, or NN-slug)

Options:
  --reason <reason>  Closure reason: wontfix | deferred | superseded | stale |
                     delivered
  --in-place         Keep the slice under <mission>/slices/ instead of moving to
                     <mission>/closed/
  --note <text>      Optional closure note
  --mission <name>   Hint mission when slice-path is just NN-slug
  --json             Machine-readable output
  -h, --help         display help for command

Workspace: the parent option --workspace selects the missions root this command reads.
  rig scope --workspace <project root> slice close ...
A project root uses its project.yaml missions.root, else its missions/ folder; a
folder named missions is used as is. Use it for a catalog project, for example
$(rig config get workspace.projects_root)/<project>. Without --workspace,
OPENRIG_WORK_ROOT applies, then the configured workspace.slices_root.
